_notes: Lives that move without you (DESIGN §8.11). Every named person in the man's orbit carries a clock: a year at a time, one of these may begin for them (a spouse ill, a job offer, a parent dying, a bottle), runs its years, and resolves one way or another. `who` is the class of person it fits (staff, clergy, classmate, family, director, confrere); `tags` narrows it (a staff desk, mother/father/sibling); `women`/`men` restrict by sex where the text needs it; `ages` by age. `line` is written when it begins, with {name} (how the sheet names them), {first}, {he}/{his}/{him}, {role} (the secretary, Fr. So-and-so, your mother); `label` is the short state on the sheets. `resolve` lists how it ends after `years`: a status for the person (dead, left, retired), a permanent mark, effects on the man, and a line. Numbers invented.

lives.label: {his} husband ill
lives.line: {name}'s husband is ill, the kind that has a name now, and {he} is at the hospital more than {he} is anywhere else.
lives.line_man: {name}'s wife is ill, the kind that has a name now, and {he} is at the hospital more than {he} is anywhere else.

resolve.line: {name}'s husband is better, or as better as he will be, and {he} is back to {his} hours and does not talk about it.
resolve.line_man: {name}'s wife is better, or as better as she will be, and {he} is back to {his} hours and does not talk about it.

resolve.line: {name}'s husband died on a Thursday. You did the funeral. {He} was back at {his} desk the Monday after, because the desk was the one thing that had not changed.
resolve.line_man: {name}'s wife died on a Thursday. You did the funeral. {He} was back the Monday after, because the work was the one thing that had not changed.

lives.label: looking at another job
lives.line: {name} has been offered a job at the parish across the river, more money and a title, and has not said so, and everyone in the office knows.

resolve.line: {name} turned the other parish down and did not say why, and is a little more {his} own since.
{name} gave notice for the job across the river, with a cake in the office and a card everyone signed.

lives.label: expecting
lives.line: {name} is expecting, and told the office before {he} told {his} mother, and the office has opinions about the leave.

resolve.line: {name} had a girl, and brought her to the office at nine days old, and you baptized her a month later.

lives.label: a parent dying, slowly
lives.line: {name}'s mother is dying, slowly, in the next county, and {he} drives there on {his} days off and comes back grey.

resolve.line: {name}'s mother died. {He} took a week, and came back, and was {himself} again by Advent, or near enough.

lives.label: a marriage coming apart
lives.line: {name}'s marriage is coming apart, and the office knows it before {he} says it, and nobody says it to {him}.

resolve.line: {name}'s divorce went through in the spring. {He} did not ask you about the tribunal, and you did not raise it, and {he} is at Mass every Sunday and does not receive.
{name} and {his} husband are trying again, and it shows, and nobody in the office mentions it.

lives.label: ill
lives.line: {name} is ill, the kind with a name and a schedule, and is keeping on as if it had neither.

resolve.line: {name} is through it, thinner, and back to the work, and does not want it mentioned.
{name} died in the spring, after a year of it. You were there at the end, or you were not, and either is a thing to carry.
{name} has retired on account of {his} health, earlier than {he} meant to, with a lunch and a speech and a chair nobody sits in.

lives.label: drinking again
lives.line: {name} is drinking again. The deanery knows it the way a deanery knows things: nobody has said it aloud, and everybody has stopped serving wine.

resolve.line: {name} went away for three months to the place the diocese sends men, and came back, and is sober, and is a different man to be in a room with, quieter and kinder.
{name} was moved quietly to a parish in the far corner of the diocese, which is how the diocese says what it will not say.
{name} has left the priesthood, or the priesthood has left him; the letter from the chancery said only that he was on leave, and he did not come back.

lives.label: worn out
lives.line: {name} is worn out in the way the older men recognise and the younger men mistake for laziness, and has stopped returning calls.

resolve.line: {name} took a sabbatical, four months, somewhere with sea in it, and came back with a beard and something of {himself}.
{name} did not come back from the sabbatical. The letter to the presbyterate was two lines long and everyone read it twice.
{name} carried on, which is what most of them do, and is a little less than {he} was, which is also what most of them do.

lives.label: thinking about leaving
lives.line: {name} is thinking about leaving. {He} has told two people, and one of them told you, which is how you know {he} wanted you to.

resolve.line: {name} stayed. Nobody knows what decided it, and {he} does not say, and is at the deanery meetings again, at the back.
{name} left the priesthood in the spring, with a letter to the men that was honest and short, and a woman nobody had met.

lives.label: failing
lives.line: {name} is failing, in the way that is not one thing but several, and the calls home have become a different kind of call.

resolve.line: {name} has steadied, with a walker and a woman who comes in the mornings, and is cross about both.
{name} died. You said the funeral Mass, because who else, and got through it, and the week after was the hardest of the year.

lives.label: moving away
lives.line: {name} is moving across the country for work, with the children, and has said it as if it were nothing, which is how you know it is not.

resolve.line: {name} moved. The calls are Sunday nights now, and the children are voices, and Christmas is every other year.

lives.label: {his} back gone
lives.line: {name}'s back has gone, lifting the crib figures, and {he} is doing the work anyway with a face, and the boiler is not getting looked at.

resolve.line: {name}'s back is better, or {he} says so, and the boiler has been looked at.
{name} retired on the back, with a lunch, and took the keys off the ring one at a time and named what each was for.

lives.label: a son thinking of the seminary
lives.line: {name}'s son is thinking about the seminary, and {name} has told you as if confessing something, and asked you not to encourage him, and to encourage him.

resolve.line: {name}'s son entered the seminary in August. {Name} cried in the office, and would not say whether from one thing or the other.
{name}'s son did not enter, in the end, and is at the state university, and {name} is relieved and will not say so.

lives.label: a grandchild coming
lives.line: {name} is to be a grandparent, and has told everyone twice, and has a photograph of a photograph.

resolve.line: {name}'s grandchild was born, and the photograph is on the desk now where the old one was, and you are asked about the baptism weekly.
